title: Releases page: laid out as a table, each release opening under its title; no repeated green notice
why: Jason, 2026-11-18: 'the release list of releases needs to be formatted like our standard table format to function better'; 'a release opens on toggle under the title'; 'once we have a green check why keep the green notification?' System Configuration → Releases now has the list's search box and one Shown filter (waiting, live, a check failed, withdrawn, rolled back or off) above a header row (Release, Where it stands, When, Files), then one row per release in those columns, its title starting with its mark; a release opens on its toggle under its title, as before. On a phone each row stacks with its labels. Filters are kept for the next visit and applied to releases the page draws again. A release that's live and well no longer shows a green notice: its mark and 'Live' say it. Only the Releases section of app/admin/sections.php and js/admin-releases.js change. FAQ: the Releases entry rewritten. Replaces releases-table (never merged), which opened each release on its own page.
